format: typst

```{r}
svpre <- read.csv("data/svpre.csv")
```
### Question 1

What was the distribution of DEM to REP Votes in CA for the Presidential Election?

### Answer 1

```{r}
svpre |>
  select(PRSDEM01, PRSREP01, COUNTY) |>
  summarize(voteDEM = sum(PRSDEM01),
            voteREP = sum(PRSREP01), .by = COUNTY) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = voteDEM, y = voteREP)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Scatterplot of CA votes by county for President")
```
